message.subject: Good experience, weak signal
message.body:
Hi there,

There is a frustrating moment many job seekers know too well. You find a job that looks like a strong match. You read the description and think: “I can do this.”
You have the skills.
You have the experience.
You understand the role.
But then you look at your CV and wonder: “Does this actually show that?”
That is where many strong candidates lose visibility. Not because they are not qualified.
But because their CV does not make the connection clear enough.


Make my CV more relevant https://tailoredcv.ai/?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tcv_nl_26_08_25_good_experience_weak_signal&utm_content=body_cta




----------------------------------------

Recruiters are not looking for your full life story.
They are looking for relevance.
They want to quickly understand why your background fits this specific role.
TailoredCV.ai https://tailoredcv.ai/?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tcv_nl_26_08_25_good_experience_weak_signal&utm_content=body_link helps you connect your real experience to the job description, so your CV speaks more clearly to the role you want.
No overclaiming.
No fake experience.
No unnecessary rewriting from zero.
Just a better version of your CV for the job you are applying for.
